input.change_text: [#1632](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/typescript-sdk/pull/1632) [`d99f3ee`](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/typescript-sdk/commit/d99f3ee5274bb17bb0eb02c85381200feb4b43e6) Thanks [@matantsach](https://github.com/matantsach)! - Continue OAuth metadata discovery on 502 (Bad Gateway) responses, matching the existing behavior for 4xx. This fixes MCP servers behind reverse proxies that return 502 for path-aware metadata URLs. Other 5xx errors still throw to avoid retrying against overloaded servers.

output.subject: @modelcontextprotocol/client OAuth metadata discovery now tolerates 502
output.action_text: Upgrade `@modelcontextprotocol/client` to 2.0.0-alpha.1+ if your MCP server runs behind a reverse proxy that returns 502 for path-aware OAuth metadata URLs. Discovery now continues on 502 like it already did on 4xx; other 5xx responses still throw to avoid hammering overloaded backends.
